warnings: Measures the HIT AREA — bounding rect plus the overhang read off each element's own ::after — never the rect. `.pa-x` is 30px of box and 44px of target, so a rect-only scan reports a legal control broken at every width. `--break=rect` is that bug on purpose.

.pa-load is INJECTED with the app's own class on the strip surfaces, because the product draws it only while a fetch is in flight. Nothing about the app is modified; a probe that waited to catch one would usually measure nothing and call it clean.
